main.description: Enumerate the calling account's clusters. The account comes from the verified token's iss, so this never takes a DID and can never be used to look at another account. This is a user verb, not an internal one: the gateway's own need to enumerate an account's workspaces is satisfied by a list against kcp with its own privileged credential, not by this call. UNPAGINATED, and it declares no parameters because it has none: an account's clusters are read as one Workspace list plus a CR read per cluster, so a page of clusters is not a page of anything the store can page. There is no limit and no cursor, and a request carrying either is not refused - undeclared query parameters are ignored. If paging is ever implemented, limit and cursor return as new OPTIONAL parameters and a cursor as a new optional output field.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token. Also returned when the token's aud is not this service or its lxm is not this method.

phase.description: Unavailable is COLD: the store is retained and controlPlaneUp will bring it back. Draining means teardown has begun and the gate is running.

running.description: The desired state, as distinct from the phase: a cluster can be running=false and still Initializing out of an earlier request.

instance.description: status.instance for this materialisation; changes on every wake and rebuild.

teardownBlocked.description: True when the teardown gate timed out. Nothing has been destroyed and an operator has to act; this is the only place that outcome is visible. Absent means no source reports it, which for a cluster that is not Draining is the same thing as false; it is never sent as false, because a false would be a claim about a condition nothing has read.

server.description: status.URL: the cluster's endpoint. Absent until the apiserver has answered at least once.
